name: Tofu Gnocchi in Spicy Tomato Sauce (Fra Diavolo) with Arugula Salad

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 red chili peppers
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby arugula
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp honey
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the water in the pot is boiling, add gnocchi and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi begins to float to the surface, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (16 oz) pkgs potato gnocchi
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the gnocchi is cooking, preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, medium dice tofu. Place in another large bowl, then sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper. Gently toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp cornstarch
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add tofu and cook, turning occasionally, until golden, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve pot for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and mince onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Quarter chili peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the onion and garlic. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Return pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, chili pepper, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes to the pot, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened slightly, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the pot with the sauce, along with the tofu and drained gnocchi, then stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add half to the bowl with the dressing, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for serving.)
To serve, divide tofu gnocchi and salad between plates or bowls. Sprinkle gnocchi with crushed red pepper and reserved Parmesan. Enjoy!
